verdict.rationale: A downloadable API spec is a fair question for a hosted inference API, so the axis applies. However, the probe found 404s at every common OpenAPI/Swagger path (cerebras-probe-3), and no doc in the pack mentions a published spec. The llms.txt and markdown docs index (cerebras-probe-1, cerebras-probe-2) are machine-readable documentation, not an API schema. OpenAI compatibility (cerebras-docs-3) suggests a third-party spec might roughly apply, but that is not a Cerebras-provided downloadable spec.
